label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
output:
**4 stars — but the four is earned, not generous.**

Moved at the end of October: 2-bed flat (mostly my own stuff, not much furniture) from Phibsborough up to Drumcondra. Fourth floor walk-up at the new place, no lift. Booked through their website, €50 deposit by Revolut, €340 quoted for up to four hours with two lads and the van.

**They were late.** I meant to arrive at 9 and they turned up at half ten. They did text at 8:40 to say the previous job had overrun, which was fair enough, but I was sat on boxes in the flat with a cold coffee waiting on them. The job itself took about three and a half hours.

I'm not going to pretend that didn't wind me up. The thing is, it wasn't the end of the world for me — I had no landlord handover deadline, no tight window, so I could absorb it. But if you're moving on a fixed time, especially if there's a landlord or letting agent waiting on the other end, build that buffer in. That's the honest bit and it's the reason this isn't five stars.

What they did well, and no I'm only saying this because it's true:

- **Dessie knocked €40 off after, and I never asked him to.** Not because I hinted, not because I complained — he just did it because they were late. That's the kind of thing that tells you something about a company.
- **The couch wouldn't go round the turn on the third floor.** One of the lads — Kev, I think — took the legs off it with an allen key he'd happened to have in his pocket and it went straight up in. No drama, no charge, problem solved in about a minute.
- **They put the bed back together for me afterwards** without being asked, and **took away a flatpack shelf** I didn't want and had no use for.
- **Best value of the quotes I got.** The others were €450 and up for the same job. For what they actually did on the day, €340 was hard to argue with.
- **They wrapped everything in blankets.** Genuinely, everything — sofa, mattress, the lot. Proper job.

**One thing though: wrap the lamps, lads.** The brass base of my nan's floor lamp got chipped, and it seems the blankets went on everything else but not that. It wasn't anything dramatic, but it was my nan's lamp so I was a bit gutted about it. It's a five-second job on the way out of the door and it would've saved me the annoyance. Worth mentioning if you're moving anything fragile — wrap it yourself before they arrive.

Would I use them again? Yeah, I would. And I'd tell anyone else moving to ring them first, because the price is genuinely good and the lads were pleasant and worked hard. If you book them, just give yourself time margin and don't leave anything delicate unwrapped.

Dessie — thanks for the €40 without me having to nag, and sorry about the lamp. No hard feelings on the timing, you were about an hour and a half late. Cheers. (He drinks in the venue I work in, so he'll definitely see this.)
